title: Abbas tere marne se duniya ujad gayi
body:
ABBAS TERE MARNE SE DUNYA UJARD GAYE
Lashe Jari pa kehte the Sarwar ba chashme tar
Tum kya gaye jahan se tooti meri kamar
Akber bhi run ko jata hai baba ko chord kar
<<MINI>>
Kis se kahun jo mujh pe qayamat guzargaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaime mein jake Zainab-e-Muztar se kya kahun
Bachon se kya kahun tere dilbar se kya kahun
Itna batado Kwahar-e-Asghar se kya kahun
<<MINI>>
Kis se kahun jo mujh pe qayamat guzargaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Bachon se bar bar Sakina ye kehti thi
Layenge pani naher se ammu mere abhi
Kaise batao aayega saqqa na ab abhi
<<MINI>>
Kis se kahun jo mujh pe qayamat guzargaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhaiya teri bhatiji ko kis darja pyas hai
Jo teen din ki pyas se wo behawaas hai
Darya pe tum gaye to Sakina ko aas hai
<<MINI>>
Kis se kahun jo mujh pe qayamat guzargaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Khaime mein leke mashk-o-alam kaise jaonga
Puchenge tujh ko Ahle haram kya bataonga
Nazren teri bhatiji se kaise milaonga
<<MINI>>
Kis se kahun jo mujh pe qayamat guzargaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Khanjar se ab katega gala tere bhaiye ka
Abbas tere dam se tha peeri mein aasra
Zainab ke sar se chhenenge zalim bhi ab rida
<<MINI>>
Kis se kahun jo mujh pe qayamat guzargaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Moosvi Sakina ka saqqa nahi raha
Thame kamar ko kehte the ye Shahe Karbala
Mashkize ko bachate huwe jaan de diya
<<MINI>>
Kis se kahun jo mujh pe qayamat guzargaye
